meta.name: api-ai-llamaindex
meta.description: LlamaIndex.TS data framework for RAG, indexing, retrieval, query engines, chat engines, and agentic workflows in TypeScript

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用TypeScript构建RAG与智能代理工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用TypeScript开发RAG或AI代理应用
copy.tagline_en: Build RAG and agentic workflows in TypeScript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building RAG or AI agent apps in TypeScript

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 TypeScript 构建 RAG 应用：加载文档、分块、建立向量索引，然后通过查询引擎或聊天引擎回答你的问题。
howto.when: 当你提到“LlamaIndex”、“向量索引”、“RAG”等关键词，或要求处理文档、建立知识库时触发。

say.text: 用 LlamaIndex 加载 ./data 目录的文档并建立索引。
创建一个查询引擎，回答关于文档内容的问题。
用 Ollama 作为本地 LLM 配置 LlamaIndex。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you build RAG applications in TypeScript: load documents, chunk them, create a vector index, then answer questions via query engine or chat engine.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "LlamaIndex", "vector index", "RAG", etc., or ask to process documents or build a knowledge base.

say_en.text: Use LlamaIndex to load documents from ./data and create an index.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code using SimpleDirectoryReader and VectorStoreIndex.

say_en.text: Create a query engine to answer questions about the documents.
say_en.note: Claude will call index.asQueryEngine() and run a query.

say_en.text: Configure LlamaIndex with Ollama as the local LLM.
say_en.note: Claude will set Settings.llm to a model from @llamaindex/ollama.
